title: The Quintessential Quintuplets
source: The Quintessential Quintuplets manga by Negi Haruba (122 chapters), including the wedding epilogue. Facts cross-checked with TQQ Chatbox's fact sheets.
world: Poor top student Futaro Uesugi takes a well-paid job tutoring the Nakano quintuplets, five identical sisters who hate studying: Ichika, Nino, Miku, Yotsuba and Itsuki. Through school trips, festivals and exams he wins their trust, and several of them fall for him. In the end Futaro chooses Yotsuba, and the sisters grow into adults with their own dreams. A warm romantic comedy about family and growing up.
power_system: No powers. Identical looks lead to many disguises and mix-ups.
